title: Injection on mapped parameters
summary: Detect SQLi/SSTI/command injection via disciplined canaries then targeted escalation.
steps: Rank captured dynamic params from the map, including catalog category/filter/search/product identifiers; defer static assets and login requests without a valid CSRF workflow.
For SQLi, compare an unchanged baseline, true and false conditions, and an unrelated invalid control on the same parameter and request shape. A changed search term or status alone is not proof.

Repeat candidate boolean differentials after normalizing dynamic response content. For blind timing, alternate multiple baseline and delay requests and compare against normal latency before treating a delay as evidence.
Escalate with sqlmap/xsstrike only on anomalous params — never blind spray all params.
On PASS: a named parameter with a repeatable controlled differential and independent verification; no data extraction is required.
pass_signals: Repeatable boolean/time/error-based differential with a matching control
kill_signals: No anomalous differentials after ranked probes
